messages:
Rhea Anand: Quick announce: rolling out a limited preview of Airgap Recovery Assistant (ARA) for Private/on‑prem installs. Designed to simplify secure emergency restores in air‑gapped environments and provide auditable, operator-friendly workflows.

Caleb Turner: TL;DR what does ARA do?

Rhea Anand: ARA provides a guided restore workflow that runs entirely in the customer's network: verify snapshot integrity, validate KMS key ownership, run preflight checks, and produce a signed restoration attestation. It also supports an operator-driven dry‑run mode for compliance teams. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ara-preview (internal).

Nikhil Desai (Security): Security notes: ARA never leaves the airgap. All attestations are signed with a customer-provided HSM key if available; fallback to local KMS is allowed per customer policy. Attestation tokens include nonce, snapshot-id, hash, operator-id, and timestamp. Retention for attestations configurable (30/180/365).

Priya Kapoor (Legal): For customer-facing comms avoid absolute phrasing like "we restore your data". Recommend: "ARA orchestrates and documents recovery operations under customer control and produces signed attestations for audit." Need to review the attestation example before external FAQ.

Marta Silva (Ops): Migration/ops Qs: Do customers need any agent upgrade? What about timeouts for large snapshots?

Rhea Anand: No mandatory agent upgrade; ARA runs as an optional Operator pod in private installs. For very large snapshots we stream and validate chunk-by-chunk; default handshake timeout = 90s but configurable. We'll publish a perf note.

Caleb Turner: Sample enablement snippet for customer templates?

Rhea Anand: Ops snippet below:

```
ara:
  enabled: true
  mode: operator-pod
  hsm:
    useCustomerKey: true
  preflight:
    checksumVerify: true
    dryRun: false
  timeouts:
    handshakeSeconds: 90
  attestation:
    retentionDays: 180
```

Nikhil Desai (Security): We'll add a compliance probe that produces a signed assertion per restore attempt. Please test on staging airgap sim before pilot.

Rhea Anand: Action items:
- Eng infra: spin up airgap sim test and validate streaming checksums (Caleb)
- Security: finalize attestation format and probe (Nikhil)
- Legal: review customer wording & attestation examples (Priya)
- Ops: draft support playbook and perf guidance (Marta)
- PM: invite 5 pilot customers and schedule technical onboarding (Rhea)

DeployBot: deploy: ara-preview v0.1 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Marta Silva (Ops): I'll reserve a GA+2 3-hour migration support window and coordinate with on-call for pilot days.

Rhea Anand: Thanks team. Please drop any blockers into the runbook and flag issues in #eng-oncall. We'll hold a walkthrough Friday 09:00 PT for anyone who wants a deep dive. :triangular_flag_on_post:
